notes: Fixed the extension's default backend URL — every fresh install (and anyone who never touched Settings → Backend URL) silently pointed at a Render backend that's now suspended ("leadloftexporter.onrender.com"), so nothing worked until you manually pasted the correct URL. All four default-settings locations (service worker, popup, options page, content-script storage) plus the manifest's host permission now point at the actual live backend. If your Options page already has a different URL saved, this doesn't touch it — only fresh/never-configured installs were affected.
